data.name: Obadric
data.long_meaning: The name Obadric is derived from the Hebrew words 'obad' meaning servant, and 'ric' meaning God. This name was borne by several important figures in the Old Testament and the New Testament, including King Obadiah of Israel and Saint Obadias, a seventh-century bishop.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reminder of one's dedication and service to God.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with the life path number 5 are known for their versatility and independence. They have a natural ability to adapt to new situations, and they thrive on change. They are often very artistic and creative.

in_hebrew.name: עובדיריק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עובדיריק הוא שם עברי שמורכב מ'עובד' שפירושו עבד או עובד ה', ומ'יריק' שיכול להיות תוספת שמות או שינוי של הסופית. השם עובדיהו מופיע בתנ'ך, ובוודאי שימש כמקור השראה לשם זה. הנושא הרוחני של שם זה קשור לעבודת ה' ולקשר עם האל.

in_greek.name: Οβαδρικός
in_greek.meaning: Ο Οβαδρικός είναι υπηρέτης του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Οβαδρικός είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από εβραϊκές ρίζες και έχει σχέση με την έννοια του υπηρέτη ή του δουλου του Θεού. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοια ονόματα συνδέονται με την έννοια της υπηρεσίας και της αφοσίωσης στον Θεό. Το πνεύμα του ονόματος συνδέεται με την υποταγή και την υπακοή στο θέλημα του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Obadricus
in_latin.long_meaning: Obadricus nomen est quod ex hebraicis radicibus oritur, significans servum Dei. In primitiva ecclesia christiana, nomina quae servitutem Dei exprimunt, erant valde popularia. Obadricus itaque nomen est quod devotionem et servitutem Deo exprimit.

in_english.name: Obadric
in_english.meaning: Servant of God or worshipper of the Lord
in_english.long_meaning: Obadric is a Christian name derived from Hebrew roots, specifically from 'Obadiah' (עובדיהו), meaning 'servant of God' or 'worshipper of the Lord'. The name Obadiah appears in the Bible (1 Kings 18:4, Malachi 3:23), signifying a devoted servant of God. Historically, the name has been used in Christian tradition to denote a person dedicated to serving God. Spiritually, Obadric symbolizes humility, devotion, and a strong bond with the divine.

biblical_reference.note: Though not directly mentioned, Obadric is inspired by Obadiah, a biblical figure.

data.cultural_impact: The name Obadric holds a significant cultural impact through its biblical origins, as it is associated with faithful and devoted servants of God. This name has been given to numerous characters in literature and art throughout history, reflecting the deep-rooted respect for obedience to God and His will.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Obadric lies in its literal meaning - a servant of God. It reminds us of our obligation as believers to serve God wholeheartedly and surrender our will to His. Obadric inspires those who bear the name to cultivate a life rooted in faith, obedience, and dedication to God's service.

historical_references.reference: Obadiah was a prophet who lived in Judah during the reigns of Jehoram, Ahaziah, and Jehoram of Judah and Ahab of Israel, around 850-840 BCE.
Obadric was a nobleman in the court of King Ahab of Israel during the time of the prophet Elijah, around 9th century BCE. He hid and protected Elijah from the wrath of Ahab.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Obadric, derived from the Hebrew 'obed' (servant) and 'drach' (people), has seen a modern resurgence in various forms of media and culture. In fantasy literature, it is a common name for noble and wise characters, as seen in works such as David Eddings' "The Belgariad" series and R.A. Salvatore's "The DemonWars Saga.". In role-playing games, it is a popular choice for player-created characters, with its strong meaning conveying a sense of duty and leadership. Lastly, in historical fiction, it is used to represent figures of power and authority, such as King Obadiah of Israel mentioned in the Bible. The name can be found on print media, such as books and magazines, tabletop gaming, in the form of character sheets and rulebooks, and video games, as a character name or in-game location.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Peter Obadric in London, United Kingdom credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Obadric, which means "Servant of God". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Obadric: Servant of God's justice and strength. A name evoking faith in God's provision and protection.
